study type: Cross-sectional (human tissue samples) and experimental (mouse model and cell culture)
exposure: Patient groups defined by parturition status (preterm delivery, full-term delivery with labor onset, full-term delivery without labor onset, non-pregnant)
cohort: Pregnant patients who underwent caesarean section (for preterm delivery, full-term delivery with labor onset, or full-term delivery without labor onset) and non-pregnant women undergoing surgery for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia III.
finding: TRPC3 gene expression in uterine smooth muscle cells was significantly overexpressed in preterm and full-term without labor onset patient groups compared to non-pregnant controls, with the highest levels in preterm delivery, while Cav1.2, Cav3.1, and Cav3.2 were highest in the full-term with labor onset group, and TRPC3 was shown to influence PLCg/PKC/CPI-17 signaling and calcium channels.
cross-section timing: Tissue samples were collected from human patients during caesarean section for delivery or during surgery for non-pregnant controls.
gest_age: Preterm and full-term (with or without labor onset) deliveries were included.
